change: Ordinary uninstall stops before removal when neither the main executable nor the registered uninstaller exists under its selected target. Update removal retains the stock lifecycle.
limits: This guard prevents an empty or unreadable selected target from being treated as a successful ordinary uninstall; it does not establish the cause of the real read-context mismatch.
If both executable files were already manually deleted, ordinary uninstall requires reinstalling first, even if other payload remains.
No new manual uninstall was performed for this package. Further install/uninstall cycles are paused at the user's request.
